sloka: मलदांश्च करूषांश्च ताटका दुष्ट चारिणी ।सा इयम् पन्थानम् आवृत्य वसति अध्यर्ध योजने ॥१-२४-२९॥
transliteration: maladāṁśca karūṣāṁśca tāṭakā duṣṭa cāriṇī ।sā iyam panthānam āvṛtya vasati adhyardha yojane ॥1-24-29॥

translations.english: Tataka lives at a distance of one and a half yojanas from here obstructing the path. Since Tataka dwells in this forest, no one comes here (because of fears).
